backlogged.summary: test/t.mjs now imports ../lib/criterion-files.mjs. Any project or sandbox that copies only t.mjs, as the old F1 test did, breaks with a module-not-found error. The tests were updated to copy the helper, but a future copy of t.mjs has to remember it too. Keeping the helper inside t.mjs would make it self-contained.

If a criterion id also appears in a comment or string of an unrelated test file, only that file runs. A test whose name is built from a template and lives elsewhere is then not run, so the check ends with 'no test matched'. This follows the frozen AC-2 fallback rule, which only applies when no file contains the id. It is a limit to be aware of, not a defect.

selectTestFiles skips dot-directories and node_modules, and a failure to read a directory is silently ignored. The old glob 'test/**/*.test.mjs' may behave differently for such directories. No test covers this difference.
